mapper.sql: id, role_code AS code, role_name AS name, data_scope AS dataScope, resource_scope AS resourceScope, enabled, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_role ORDER BY id LIMIT 1001
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role(role_code, role_name, data_scope, resource_scope, enabled) VALUES (#{entity.code}, #{entity.name}, #{entity.dataScope}, #{entity.resourceScope}, #{entity.enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET role_code = #{entity.code}, role_name = #{entity.name}, data_scope = #{entity.dataScope}, resource_scope = #{entity.resourceScope}, enabled = #{entity.enabled}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{entity.id} AND version = #{entity.version}
